summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from Alpha Tau Medical Ltd., a foreign private issuer, attaching two press releases about the treatment of the first pancreatic cancer patient in a European clinical trial (ACAPELLA) and an FDA approval for an expansion of a U.S. trial (IMPACT). These are routine operational updates regarding clinical progress, not a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring. The filing does not contain any terms, recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics typical of a special-situation event. It is a periodic disclosure of business developments with no deal-related activities.
